subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Pandemic Risk After COVID
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Pandemic Risk After COVID.

hook.text: In 2020, a virus shut down the global economy. Most business plans never considered a pandemic.

buildup.text: Supply chains collapsed, offices closed, and entire industries lost billions overnight.

discovery.text: Epidemiologists warned for decades that a pandemic was inevitable. Most organizations ignored them.

twist.text: Pandemic was on every risk register — high impact, low probability. Then it became high everything.

climax.text: COVID proved that low-probability risks on paper can become certainties without warning.

punchline.text: Low probability isn't zero. COVID proved it.

quiz.question: What risk lesson did COVID reinforce?
options: Low-probability high-impact risks need real planning
Pandemics are too rare to plan for
